question: Deploy MV3DT on my calibrated 4-camera MP4 dataset. Which skill and deployment path should be used? Do not run anything.
ground_truth: Generic MV3DT requests route to the standalone RT-CV-3D skill. The workflow uses services/rtvi/rt-cv-3d/rt-cv-mv3dt/docker/compose.yml, generates configs from calibration.json, stages INPUT_MODE=file, defaults to bundled mosquitto+kafka, and does not use warehouse compose files.
expected_behavior: Loads vss-deploy-detection-tracking-3d for generic MV3DT intent.
Identifies the standalone compose path under services/rtvi/rt-cv-3d/rt-cv-mv3dt/docker/compose.yml.
Uses COMPOSE_PROFILES=mosquitto,kafka docker compose up -d as the default bundled-broker launch path.
Reports resolved runtime images only from docker compose config --images and does not hardcode a runtime image version.
Does not mention warehouse compose as the deployment path.
Does not print plaintext API tokens.

question: I want warehouse MV3DT as part of the full warehouse blueprint with the rest of the warehouse services. Which skill should handle that?
ground_truth: Explicit warehouse MV3DT requests route away from the standalone RT-CV-3D skill to the warehouse/profile deployment skill and warehouse compose files.
expected_behavior: Routes explicit warehouse-blueprint MV3DT intent to vss-deploy-profile or the warehouse deployment references.
Explains that vss-deploy-detection-tracking-3d is the default for standalone MV3DT but not for combined warehouse deployment.
Does not instruct the user to use the standalone compose file for the full warehouse blueprint.
Does not print plaintext API tokens.

question: Deploy RTVI-CV-3D but use MQTT broker broker.example.com:1883 and Kafka kafka.example.com:19092. Do not deploy yet.
ground_truth: The standalone skill supports the basic external host:port broker path: validate endpoints, generate MQTT pub/sub config with MQTT_BROKERS, launch compose without bundled broker profiles, and verify Kafka against the external bootstrap. TLS/auth variants remain delegated to README.
expected_behavior: Collects and validates MQTT_HOST, MQTT_PORT, and KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP.
Runs MQTT_BROKERS=broker.example.com:1883 ./scripts/generate-configs.sh.
Verifies generated pub_sub_info_config.yml contains broker.example.com:1883.
Launches without COMPOSE_PROFILES=mosquitto,kafka for the external-broker path.
Uses configured KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP for mdx-raw/mdx-bev verification.
Does not print plaintext API tokens.

question: Run rtvi-cv-3d on my synchronized cam_*.mp4 files, but I do not have calibration yet. Walk me through the order without running anything.
ground_truth: The skill identifies missing calibration, hands off to vss-generate-video-calibration first, requires successful AMC export, validates camera-only calibration sensors, returns to standalone config generation, staging, bundled broker compose launch, and verification.
expected_behavior: Chains to vss-generate-video-calibration because calibration is missing.
Does not ignore a failed AMC export_calibration POST or silently reuse an old calibration.json.
Validates exported calibration JSON using camera-only sensors with safe unique ids.
Resolves BEV_DATASET_PATH only after map.png and transforms.yml are both present.
Uses standalone compose and bundled brokers for the deployment plan.
Does not mention warehouse calibration mount paths.
Does not print plaintext API tokens.
